why: The desk's ledger of outside reporting: facts EdgeDesk's own data cannot measure (an injury update, how a game unfolded, a coach's comment), each with the outlet, the URL, when the SOURCE published it, who recorded it and when it stops being current. lib/football_evidence.js reads it into each matchup's evidence packet. A REPORTED fact was recorded from the outlet's published reporting but not opened and confirmed at the source by an EdgeDesk editor: an article may cite it with attribution, and the article is HELD FOR REVIEW until an editor confirms it (node tools/content/add_fact.js --verify <id> --by NAME). Facts already here and current are never looked up again. Add one with tools/content/add_fact.js; a fact without a URL, a publication date or a recorder is refused.
